summary.business_type: Niche digital creative and technology studio serving salons, stylists, hair-care brands, and selected businesses
top_findings: Work and Services HTML is accidentally cached as immutable for one year
The homepage repeats too much portfolio and motion content
No canonical tags or structured data exist
The five-page architecture cannot capture specific commercial search intent
The site lacks founder identity, testimonials, case-study outcomes, and measurement
quick_wins: Fix Work and Services cache headers
Add canonical URLs and normalize trailing slashes
Move the niche audience and booking outcome into the first viewport
Compress and clip the desktop hero video

findings.title: Immutable HTML caching
findings.description: Work and Services HTML returns a one-year immutable cache header.
findings.recommendation: Restrict immutable rules to actual media assets.

findings.title: Missing canonical tags
findings.description: All five indexable pages lack canonical URLs.
findings.recommendation: Add absolute self-referencing canonicals using final trailing-slash URLs.

findings.title: Redirecting sitemap/internal URLs
findings.description: Slashless URLs redirect to slash URLs.
findings.recommendation: Update sitemap and internal links to final 200 URLs.

findings.title: Homepage overload
findings.description: Multiple galleries, films, and proof modules repeat the same message.
findings.recommendation: Reduce homepage content by 25-35% and move depth to Work/case studies.

findings.title: Abstract services
findings.description: Capability categories do not answer buyer questions about deliverables, price, timeline, platforms, or ownership.
findings.recommendation: Productize Websites + Booking, Commerce + Content, and Automation + Care.

findings.title: Generic inner-page targeting
findings.description: Titles and artistic H1s underuse salon website and booking intent.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit commercial search language while retaining expressive headings.

findings.title: Shallow architecture
findings.description: Only five routes exist and portfolio links mostly leave the site.
findings.recommendation: Create service pages and internal case studies.

findings.title: No structured data
findings.description: Zero JSON-LD, microdata, or RDFa blocks exist.
findings.recommendation: Add truthful Organization, WebSite, WebPage, Service, BreadcrumbList, and CollectionPage data.

findings.title: Oversized desktop hero
findings.description: The 10.4 MB hero video contains more footage than the 12-second displayed range.
findings.recommendation: Clip, recompress, and provide modern and fallback formats.

findings.title: No responsive image delivery
findings.description: All 75 rendered images lack intrinsic dimensions and responsive sources.
findings.recommendation: Add width/height and srcset/sizes or an equivalent image pipeline.

findings.title: Weak citability
findings.description: There are few named experts, dated facts, client quotes, or measurable outcomes.
findings.recommendation: Publish attributable case studies, founder bios, service facts, and first-party results.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All rendered images include alt attributes

findings.title: Missing intrinsic dimensions
findings.description: Images do not provide width and height attributes.
findings.recommendation: Add dimensions to reduce layout-shift risk.

findings.title: Oversized PNG assets
findings.description: Several PNGs are between 1.4 MB and 2.8 MB.
findings.recommendation: Convert delivery assets to optimized WebP/AVIF where appropriate.
